summary: Fully playable, modern, interactive Yut Nori (윷놀이) Korean traditional board game web application with 4 real-time themes (Traditional, Modern Minimalist, Neon Cyber, Cute Cartoon), 29-station Mal-pan with 4 routes & shortcuts, realistic 3D-style Yut stick throwing animations, Mal stacking & capturing, 2-Player Hotseat & Smart AI modes, Web Audio sound synthesis, and rules guide.
